name: Breath of Death
doc: Breath of Death: the GF cinematic engine's clone run from the two script files (mag231_b.00 / .01, its parameters) - its bones, prims, sprites and particles, the action results. The program calls the clone's own setup (the engine's state block is shared, one clone at a time), its root re-pointed at the program's director; the tick is the port's (FFNx mag232_breath_of_death.cpp), the file loader ProgramFiles' (gfc_engine.h).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Darkness
parts.doc: The battle's stage darkens while the ghost breathes, and lifts once the swirls start (the stage only: the models and the effect stay as they are)

parts.title: Ghost
parts.doc: A blue copy of the caster (its own model and animations, drawn with the model's own blend) that comes out of it, breathes, flies to the target and sinks. The purple line is the way it goes

parts.title: Dark breath
parts.doc: The black smoke: breathed by the caster, then by the ghost. Its darkening blend is in its sprite (Textures tab, Sections)

parts.title: Gathering sparks
parts.doc: The sparks that rise from the caster before the ghost comes out. Their blend is in their sprite (Textures tab, Sections)

parts.title: Swirl 1 (pink)

parts.title: Swirl 2 (dark)
parts.doc: The dark disc: a second model turning around the target's feet

parts.title: Blue wisps
